hero.tagline: Where great golf meets great company

pages.title: Welcome
body: Welcome to Tee Gras Exchange Day, a celebration of friendly competition, camaraderie, and the joy of the game.
This special inter-league event brings together players from across BL9 for a day of golf, festivities, and Mardi Gras-inspired fun on the course.
Whether you are a seasoned player or joining us for the first time, we are thrilled to have you. Let the good times roll!

pages.title: Arrival and Check-In
body: Arrive at least 30 minutes before your tee time
Check in at the registration table near the clubhouse
Pick up your welcome bag with scorecard, tees, and Mardi Gras beads
Review your team assignment and starting hole
Warm up on the practice green and driving range
Gather with your foursome at the staging area 10 minutes before shotgun start

pages.title: Tournament Format
body: The format for Tee Gras Exchange Day is a Shamble. Each player tees off, the team selects the best drive, and all players play their own ball from that spot into the hole.
Teams are mixed foursomes, blending players from different BL9 chapters to encourage new connections and spirited play.
Handicaps will be applied. Full rules and local ground rules will be provided at check-in.

pages.title: Dress Code
body: Mardi Gras colors encouraged: purple, green, and gold
Standard golf attire required (collared shirts, golf shoes)
Beads, fun accessories, and festive flair are welcome
Costume contest prizes for best-dressed team
Comfortable layers recommended for morning tee times

pages.title: Awards and Prizes
body: 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place team awards
Closest to the pin on designated par 3s
Longest drive contest
Best-dressed team award
Door prizes and raffle drawings at the awards luncheon

pages.title: Pro Shop and On-Course
body: The pro shop will be open before and after the round for merchandise, accessories, and last-minute supplies.
On-course beverage carts will be circulating throughout the event. Complimentary water stations are available at holes 4, 9, and 14.
A photographer will be on course capturing the day's highlights. Photos will be shared with all participants after the event.

pages.title: Helpful Links
body: Find everything you need for the day below.

pages.title: Questions?
body: Have a question about the event, your registration, or anything else? Reach out and we will be happy to help.

pages.title: See You on the Course
body: Thank you for being part of Tee Gras Exchange Day. We can not wait to share this celebration with you.
Play well, have fun, and laissez les bons temps rouler!
